groups.title: The models represent the contract behaviour correctly.

parts.A-SOURCE-SHAPED: We assume the handwritten Lean models represent the Solidity behaviour described by this guarantee.
parts.A-HANDWRITTEN-MINFIRST: The independent min-first model is handwritten. Its full correspondence with Solidity and EVM execution remains open.
parts.A-ABSTRACT-TX: The model defines transaction success and failure without executing EVM bytecode.
parts.A-VERITY-SCAFFOLD: We also assume Verity correctly models the calls, storage and rollback used by these proofs.
parts.A-YUL-INTERFACE: The handwritten Yul and direct bytecode require a separate correspondence proof; this report does not connect them to Solidity.

groups.mitigation: The linked code and correspondence notes let you review what is modeled and what remains open. Tests and mutations check specific cases; they do not establish full correspondence.

groups.title: The deployed contracts correspond to the source we reviewed.

parts.A-SOLC-TRUSTED: We assume the compiler and compilation pipeline preserve the source behaviour.
parts.A-RUNTIME-PROVENANCE: We assume the deployed contracts and proxy implementations correspond to the pinned source.

groups.mitigation: The verification guide provides external checks of implementation addresses, on-chain code and verified source bundles. Its --recompile option prints instructions; it does not run a local compilation. Compiler correctness remains trusted.

groups.title: The configured addresses and deposit amounts match the deployment.

parts.A-DEPOSIT-CONTRACT: We assume the configured deposit recipient is the deployed beacon deposit contract.
parts.A-TOPUP-BEACON-ADDRESS: We assume the configured top-up recipient is the deployed beacon deposit contract.
parts.A-CANONICAL-REQUEST-ADDRESS: We assume the configured consolidation request target matches the canonical deployed predeploy.
parts.A-DEPOSIT-32-ETHER: We assume both per-validator deposit amounts equal 32 ETH in the deployment.

groups.mitigation: Compare constructor arguments and immutables with deployment artifacts. The verification guide does not establish all of these identities; matching the amounts alone does not identify the recipient.
